protocol: read-only focus-aware route/preflight summary; no training, no threshold tuning, no checkpoint loading, no NPZ array loading, no split/cache mutation
evidence_semantics: Fields named evidence in Loop108 route/preflight reports are authorization audit summaries only. They are not model features, verdict evidence, threshold signals, fusion inputs, relabel evidence, replacement-sampling evidence, or production inference evidence.

identity_feature_policy.deployment_boundary: Real deployment names do not match training-corpus names. Directory or filename inference can only bootstrap a human-curated label manifest; after the locked 20w split exists, names and paths are logistics metadata only.

next_allowed_step: Independent content/external verdicts must be added to the blinded review route before redraw preflight, Train/Val, Test-10k, or full-test can be allowed.
